# Walter Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c17 P32](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0032)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Walter  <sub>[v5 c17 P8](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Walter is considered the handsomest of the Ingleside children, with finely modelled features and straight black hair. He possesses dark gray, splendid eyes that convey deep emotion and joy, sorrow, and loyalty. He does not resemble any known relative in his looks.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013)_

## Personality

Walter possesses a vivid imagination, a deep love of ghost stories, and a passionate love of beauty. Highly dramatic, he enjoys playing on the feelings of his companions and waking their fears. He is quiet and prone to day-dreaming, often preferring to read poetry alone in out-of-the-way corners rather than participate in fights or school sports. Sensitive and empathetic, he tends to take the blame on himself, while strongly disliking physical pain, ugly things, and seeing others get hurt.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c8 P27](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0027), [v5 c11 P1](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0001), [v5 c12 P26](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0026), [v5 c16 P14](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0014), [v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016), [v5 c16 P25](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0025), [v5 c29 P8](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0008)_

## History

Walter grew up at Ingleside as one of the Blythe children, frequently spending his evenings reading aloud or playing with his siblings and friends in Rainbow Valley. Despite being considered soft or timid by fellow students at Glen St. Mary school due to his dislike of sports and fighting, he earned respect for his eloquent way of talking. He spent much of his time writing secret poetry and an epic, sharing his writings exclusively with his sister Di. After Dan Reese insulted both Walter's mother and Faith Meredith, Walter overcame his deep-seated horror of violence and fought Dan after school, gaining the victory. Following the fight, Walter declared he would no longer be afraid of things and resolved to have his aching tooth pulled.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c3 P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 c8 P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 c16 P20](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0020), [v5 c16 P25](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0025), [v5 c17 P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 c17 P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041), [v5 c17 P56](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0056), [v5 c17 P62](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0062), [v5 c17 P71](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0071)_

## Quotes

> I hate being hurt. Father said he wouldn’t insist on my going—he’d wait until I’d made up my own mind to go.  <sub>[v5 c16 P14](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0014)</sub>

> The bleeding is worst of all—it’s so ugly...  <sub>[v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016)</sub>

> He insulted you and he insulted my mother... Tonight after school, Dan.  <sub>[v5 c17 P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016)</sub>

> Dan Reese said my mother wrote lies and that that Faith was a pig-girl...  <sub>[v5 c17 P62](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0062)</sub>

> I was a whole lot frightened... But I’m not going to be frightened any more, sir. Being frightened of things is worse than the things themselves. I’m going to ask father to take me over to Lowbridge to-morrow to get my tooth out.  <sub>[v5 c17 P71](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0071)</sub>
